story.title: This Arlington teen started a new homecoming tradition for classmates without mums
story.summary: Libby Deakyne, 17, created Mum-Making Day to help Arlington High students feel included. Her work earned her a spot on the 18 Under 18 list. Growing up in Arlington, Libby Deakyne always admired the elaborate strands of ribbon and oversized flowers that make up a Texas homecoming mum. But when she started her freshman year at Arlington High School, she noticed some students weren’t able to participate in the beloved Texas homecoming tradition. Mums can be expensive, and some students could not afford to partake. So, Libby decided to help her classmates. She established Mum-Making Day at her high school and gathered the materials, raised money and organized volunteers.
